tasks_completed.description: Add minWidth: 0 to messageContent style in MessageView.tsx
tasks_completed.changes: Inserted 'minWidth: 0,' as first property of messageContent style (line 211). Matches prod commit a59b3795.
tasks_completed.rationale: Without minWidth: 0, flexbox's implicit content-size minimum prevents messageContent (flex:1) from shrinking below its content width — the overflowX:auto wrapper in MarkdownView has no effect because its ancestor widens beyond the card.

tasks_completed.description: Add maxWidth: '100%' and overflow: 'hidden' to agentMessageContainer style in MessageView.tsx
tasks_completed.changes: Added maxWidth: '100%' (line 237) and overflow: 'hidden' (line 238) after alignSelf: 'flex-start'. Matches prod commit a59b3795.
tasks_completed.rationale: agentMessageContainer needs explicit width bound so wide tables cannot push the card beyond the message column width; overflow:hidden clips any residual bleed beyond the borderRadius:16 boundary.

git_rationale.root_cause_commit: a59b3795 — fix: table font mismatch and mobile overflow on web (2026-03-25, /root/happy)
git_rationale.why_issue_occurred: The dev worktree branched from a base predating commit a59b3795. The MarkdownView.tsx portion of the fix was backported but the MessageView.tsx portion was missed.
git_rationale.how_fix_addresses_root: Ports the 3 missing style properties byte-for-byte from the production commit. The flexbox ancestor-container constraints (minWidth:0 + maxWidth:100% + overflow:hidden) combine with the already-present MarkdownView.tsx overflowX:auto wrapper to produce horizontally-scrollable tables bounded by the card.

dev.qa_notes: Verify on dev.life-ai.app (NEVER life-ai.app): send a message containing a 3+ column markdown table with wide content to an active agent session (e.g., '| Path | Type | Content |\n|---|---|---|\n| /very/long/path/file.tsx | modified | A very long content description that should overflow |'). On desktop 1440x900, expect table to be horizontally scrollable inside the agent card with no bleed beyond the card's right edge. On mobile 390x844 (use browser_resize before navigate), same expectation — table scrolls within card, no screen overflow. Short text messages and single-column tables should be visually identical to pre-fix. Blast radius: 2 importers of MessageView (ChatList.tsx, messages-demo.tsx) — both render message views and should display normally.
